markdown:
| Type of Settling | Overflow rate, cum/sqm/day / Average | Overflow rate, cum/sqm/day / Peak | Solid loading, kg/day/sqm / Average | Solid loading, kg/day/sqm / Peak | Side Water Depth, m / Average | Weir loading, cum/m/day / Average |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Primary Clarifiers |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Primary Settling only | 25 - 30 | 50 - 60 | Not applicable | Not applicable | ≥ 2.5 - 3.5 | 125 |
| Followed by secondary treatment | 35 - 50 | 80 - 120 | Not applicable | Not applicable | ≥ 2.5 - 3.5 | 125 |
| With excess sludge return | 25 - 35 | 50 - 60 | Not applicable | Not applicable | ≥ 3.5 - 4.5 | 125 |
| Secondary Clarifiers |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Secondary settling for activated sludge | 15 - 35 | 40 - 50 | 70 - 140 | 210 | ≥ 3.0 - 3.5 | 185 |
| Secondary settling for extended aeration | 8 - 15 | 25 - 35 | 25 - 120 | 170 | ≥ 3.0 - 4.0 | 185 |
notes: Two-tier printed header flattened with / : "Type of Settling" spans both header tiers, "Overflow rate, cum/sqm/day" and "Solid loading, kg/day/sqm" each have printed Average and Peak sub-columns, and "Side Water Depth, m" and "Weir loading, cum/m/day" each carry a printed second-level Average.
Primary Clarifiers and Secondary Clarifiers are printed as full-width group headings; retained as rows with empty value cells and recorded in cell_spans.

The printed Not applicable cell for the three primary-clarifier rows is a single cell spanning the Solid loading Average and Peak columns; its text is repeated in both cells and the merge is recorded in cell_spans.
Note: Where the mechanized aerobic treatment is used after UASB reactor, the settling tank design shall be based on conventional activated sludge process as above.
Source: CPHEEO, 1993 and as recommended in the present manual
Printed ≥ symbols and hyphen spacing (for example 25 - 30 and ≥ 3.5 - 4.5) are retained as printed.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page PNGs, plus enlarged crops at 288-720 dpi and a contact sheet of every hashed source region; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
transcription.observations: First visual transcription only. Every printed glyph, power, subscript, inequality, unit, hyphen spacing, footnote and printed error was read from the rendered source and retained or flagged; no value inferred.
